Game Overview

World Z Defense - Zombie Defense is a action game built around defend humanity in a post-apocalyptic world by strategically deploying unique soldiers to fend off relentless zombie hordes. Balance weapon stats, reload speed, and shooting range to protect your bases. Earn rewards to upgrade defenses and unlock powerful abilities. Outsmart the undead and save cities from destruction!
